dakzahastAByAM vyAKyAM varRasya mAlikAm ॥ amftena taTA pUrRaM GawaM divyaYca pustakam । daDatIM vAmahastAByAM pInastanaBarAnvitAm ॥ maDye kzIRAM taTA svacCAM nAnAratnaviBUzitAm AtmABedena DyAtvEvaM tataH ॥ aNgEH praTamA vfttiH syAt dvitIyA SaktiBistataH । dalAgrezu samaByarccya brahmARyAdyA yaTAviDi ॥ lokapAlA bahiH pUjyAstezAmastrARi tadDvahiH । evaM sampUjayenmantrI japahomaratastadA ॥ kavitvaM laBate vAgmI lakzErdvAdaBirDruvam । prAtarjaptvA sahasrantu pibedbrAhmIM vacAnvitAm na vismarati meDAvI SrutAn vedAgamAnapi । kaRWamAtrodake sTitvA DyAyenmArttaRqamaRqale ॥ jyotiHpuYjaniBAM m: सार्ष्ट्य n. a partic. state of Mukti (see above).
